_about: Trusted manufacturer catalogue for Zava Marketplace. Sellers list against a GTIN; the gate looks up these facts by GTIN. All brands and GTINs are fictional (GS1 prefix 200-299 is reserved for restricted circulation, so these never collide with real products). 'split' assigns every listing for a product to one dataset split, so a product never appears in two splits.
